principle: Story and Online both support a persistent-feeling civilian economy alongside criminal gameplay.
cash: Player wallet and bank balances are separate. Cash can be stolen/lost in defined events; bank balance is protected except for authored financial systems.

rules: Prices move from world events, business performance, player demand and authored story events
Story mode may use authored market shocks
Players can buy/sell holdings and see gains/losses

dark_web.name: BlackNet
rules: Purchases resolve through fictional game inventory and activities
High-risk purchases can trigger scams, police heat or ambushes
Online server validates every order and delivery
